title: I built a Top100-style leaderboard for AI / vibe-coded games. Free to list, dofollow backlink included.
author: CuntsAndBluntss
selftext:
I just launched, and it's already gaining a lot of traction.          



I Spent the last few weeks building a Top100-style leaderboard for AI / vibe-coded games.                                                         



  What you get when you list:                                                                                    



  \- Dofollow backlink from a niche-relevant site                                                                 

  \- A shareable vote URL you can drop in your Discord or Twitter                                                 

  \- Category traffic (RPG, Roguelike, Strategy, Adventure, etc.)

  \- Vote callback API so you can grant in-game rewards on every confirmed vote                                 



 No paywall, no email farm, no upsell. Submission takes 1 minute.

VibeTopList will be heavily advertised, and marketing. Don't miss out on being an early adopter.



 [vibetoplist.com](https://vibetoplist.com)

comments.body: This is not working for me. No email gets sent for confirmation

replies.author: CuntsAndBluntss
replies.body:
Some e-mail custom domains might not be properly set-up. Try to create an account with a regular Gmail/Hotmail/Outlook account if you have one. That should 100% work.

I will look into the issue why it didn't send it to your custom domain, but it might potentially also be an issue with your mailserver settings.

Let me know!

comments.author: amebaboys
comments.body: That actually looks pretty cool, especially the leaderboard part, makes tracking progress more fun. If youre planning to get more visibility for it, might be worth getting a few backlinks from tech blogs or AI-related sites. RentalBacklinks could be a cheap way to start if you just wanna test traffic, and if you ever wanna go the editorial route, Bazoom or Linkatomic usually have real sites you can post on, just pricier. I tried something similar for a side project and traffic picked up way faster than I expected once the links kicked in.

replies.author: CuntsAndBluntss
replies.body: Thank you for your kind words and suggestions!
